summary: KLA Corp filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting held November 4, 2026, after which it disclosed a routine quarterly dividend. Holders of 89.33% of the 1,305,006,492 entitled shares participated. Stockholders elected nine director nominees, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor for fiscal 2027, and approved executive compensation on an advisory basis. Jason Conley did not stand for re-election, ending his term November 4. The board declared a $0.23 per-share cash dividend payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record November 16, 2026. No transactional event; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
